reports.summary:
A-window is done for this wave. The earlier fixes for items (a) to (d) still hold on the current tree, and items (e) and (f) are fixed or covered by decision D055. Nobody has verified any of it yet, and nothing ran in the real window (this wave allows no live UI).

What changed this time:
(f1) Fullscreen top edge. When the pointer reaches the top edge, macOS shows its own strip (menu bar and titlebar) as a separate window, so this window never sees the pointer. Now the toolbar is hidden in fullscreen, as VLC's own video windows do, so the strip holds only the menu bar and the titlebar with the traffic lights. The controller reads the strip window's frame. The reveal logic shows the top bar when the strip appears and draws it right below the strip. The bar keeps that place until it hides, so it does not slide away from a pointer coming down from the menu bar.
(f2) Light. The video was drawn edge to edge under the bars in Light only (a separate full-bleed path). Now the background still runs under the translucent bars, but the picture stays between the pinned bars. Switching theme or opening the library no longer rescales the video, and subtitles are not hidden under the control bar. The S72 render is unchanged next to Figma.
(f3) A hidden bar is now removed from the view tree, so no tooltip can stay after it fades.
(f4) Turning Hide UI off reopens the right panel that was open before.
(f5) The end of a fullscreen video now follows VLC: the window leaves fullscreen only if it went fullscreen while a video was playing.
(f6) The window now reports how much of the picture the control bar covers (InterfaceModel.subtitleSafeInset). C-bridge's in-progress setSubtitleSafeInset command still has to be wired to it. The compact library is covered by a decision: it overlays the side of the picture, and VLC can only move subtitles vertically.
(f7) Resume toast. The real cause is in the bridge, not the media length. Files played from outside an indexed folder have no duration in the media library, so the bridge sent time −1 and no toast ever appeared (seen headlessly with S01E03: progress 0.177 saved, duration −1). The bridge now uses the player's length. The 60 s files would very likely show the toast too after this fix, but that was not tested.
(e) S01.Window/shipping now passes, with deviations citing D022. D007's wording is fixed, and the redundant cone tints are removed.
fixed: (f1) MAJOR fullscreen top-edge reveal: the toolbar is hidden in fullscreen. MXRAppController watches the strip window (standardWindowButton(.closeButton).window) and sets InterfaceModel.fullscreenSystemInset. PlayerChromeReveal pins the top bar while the strip shows and sets a sticky topBarOffset; MXRAppView draws the bar, the compact library, the panels and the info area below it. Evidence: build/evidence/final4/A-window/menubar_top_crop.png, S05_fullscreen_vs_menubar.png, new gallery entry S05.Window/fullscreen-menubar. Tests: WindowLiveFindingsTests.testMacOSFullscreenStripRevealsTheTopBarBelowItAndItStaysReachable, testSystemStripInsetFollowsTheStripWindowFrame, testAWindowNeverOffsetsItsTopBar.

(f2) MAJOR Light-only rescale: PlayerCanvasStyle.resolve sent Light to .fullBleed. The new .underBars style keeps the background under the bars and puts the picture between them; the OSD uses the picture rect. Evidence: S72_light_before_after_figma.png (before, after and Figma are visually identical; bar pixels unchanged). Test: testLightKeepsThePictureBetweenThePinnedBars, which fails on the old code at y 20.
(f3) Tooltip left after the bars hide: hidden bars now leave the tree (the fade is a transition). Test: testHiddenBarsLeaveTheViewTree, which fails on the old code (2 vs 1).
(f4) Hide UI off now reopens the panel that was open (InterfaceModel.toggleUIHidden). Test: testTurningHideUIOffReopensThePanelThatWasOpen, which fails on the old code.
(f5) End of media in fullscreen: the window now leaves fullscreen only if fullscreen was entered while a video was playing, matching VLCVideoOutputProvider handleVideoCloseForDisplay (D055).

(f6) The UI side of the subtitle inset: InterfaceModel.subtitleSafeInset is the control-bar height while that bar overlays the picture (fullscreen, Customize), otherwise 0. Test: testRevealedFullscreenControlBarReportsTheSubtitleInset. The rest is in D055.

(f7) Resume toast never appeared for external media: in MXRServicesBridge.m, when the media library has no duration, the time comes from vlc_player_GetLength, both in the media-library reply and in stateSnapshot. Headless evidence: build/evidence/final4/A-window/home (ml.db: S01E03 last_position 0.1767, duration −1). The native plugin compiles under the lock.

(e) S01.Window/shipping: deviations cite D022 for the left group after the traffic lights and for the right group without Windows controls; the verdict is now PASS (check_S01/side-by-side.png). D007 is amended (the default top bar has no PiP button). Redundant tint: Theme.Color.accentLogo removed from MXRIcon(.vlc) in PlayerBars.swift and PlayerView.swift.
(e) B-controls' PlayerInteractionTests (108 vs 54) now passes at the current tree.

Earlier in this wave (still holding on the current tree): S66 Customize band, modal host centring and clipping in the shipping window, App* entries keep the top bar under --engine shipping-window, --scheme/--accent reach shipping-window entries, entries S67.Window/two-row, S05.Window/fullscreen and S12.Window/continue-minimum, S72 fixture media, narrow cat fixture, resume toast below ~400 pt, Settings gate strict. Suites rerun green: WindowShippingParity, WindowComposition, PlayerInteraction, OSDLayout, ContinueWatchingToast, CustomizationInteraction, FigmaDeviation, GalleryRender, ModalIsolation, WindowLiveFindings.

issues.description: At the 480 pt minimum window the toast no longer overflows, but the button label is cut to 'Continue Watchi…'. The toast stays inside the video, but the primary action is truncated. An icon-only or shorter fallback would read better. The compact library also overflows its 216 pt column there (E-library's, already passed on).

The D022 deviations leave out the whole left-group rect (padding + left group + traffic-light reserve) and the whole right group 247:464. The cone, ⋯, sidebar toggle, chip and fullscreen glyph are therefore not compared at all in this entry; they are not compared shifted. Each deviation cites D022 honestly, but this is wider than the actual difference (a horizontal offset and the missing Windows buttons). Narrowing it to the Windows-button rect, plus a shifted comparison of the left group, would keep the icons under the gate.

For external media (media-library duration -1) the resume time now comes from vlc_player_GetLength, with a fallback in stateSnapshot once the input has a length. The logic is correct as read, but nothing tests it (no bridge smoke test), and it is unverified until the live wave.

How far the fullscreen strip covers the window is read from didMove/didResize/occlusion notifications of the titlebar window. Whether AppKit posts these while it animates the menu-bar reveal cannot be proved offscreen, so the whole f1 fix depends on live check A-fs-topedge. The state machine itself (pin while the strip shows, keep the offset until the bar hides) is tested.

verdict.summary:
A-window verification, round 1: PASS. Code, tests and renders show no remaining blocker or major issue.

**Build and tests**
- `swift build` is clean.
- The targeted suites all pass on the shared tree: WindowLiveFindings 7, WindowComposition 12, WindowShippingParity 6, PlayerInteraction 11 (B-controls' 108 vs 54 failure is reconciled), ContinueWatchingToast 3, CustomizationInteraction 11, FigmaDeviation 5, GalleryRender 13, OSDLayout 2, ModalIsolation 6. Log: ../build/evidence/final4/A-window-verify-r1/tests.log.
- Regression check: in an isolated copy I reverted the Light canvas fix (back to fullBleed) and the Hide UI panel-restore fix. testLightKeepsThePictureBetweenThePinnedBars failed at y 20, and testTurningHideUIOffReopensThePanelThatWasOpen failed with nil vs queue, as they should. The copy has since been deleted.

**Renders I looked at** (shipping-window, in ../build/evidence/final4/A-window-verify-r1/r/)
- S66.Window/customization: the empty 54 pt second-row band sits at 972–1026 above the control row, as in Player - customize.
- S67.Window/two-row: matches customize-7, with the seek row above the transport and the reduced top bar.
- S25.App/add-subtitles: the dialog is centred at 140–940 and the top bar is present.
- S37.App/convert-compact: the dialog runs 20–520 with no clipping.
- S72.App/light and S66.App/customization: both keep the top bar (the tooling trap is fixed).
- S05.Window/fullscreen-menubar: the top bar is drawn below a 52 pt strip.
- S12.Window/continue-minimum: no overflow, but the label is truncated (minor).
- `check` results: S01.Window/shipping PASS with D022/D048 deviations. S72.Window/light FAILs only on bar colour, an offscreen blur limitation covered by D053. S66.App FAILs only on the dialog body fill, a backdrop artifact.

**Work list**
- (a)–(d) All addressed.
- (e) Done: S01 deviations cite D022, D007 is amended, the redundant accentLogo tints are removed, and --scheme/--accent reach shipping-window entries.
- (f1) The toolbar is hidden in fullscreen, the strip window is observed, and the top bar is pinned and offset below the strip. This follows VLC's VLCFullVideoViewWindow and native conventions. It is unit-tested, but it still needs the live check.
- (f2) The cause is the Light→fullBleed path. The new underBars style keeps the picture between the bars. This is a reasonable root-cause fix, and D055's justification (geometry stable across themes, subtitles not under the bar) is sound.
- (f3) Hidden bars now leave the view tree.
- (f4) Fixed and tested.
- (f5) The end-of-video exit now follows VLC's handleVideoCloseForDisplay semantics.
- (f6) InterfaceModel.subtitleSafeInset is computed and is now observed in MXRAppController and sent to the backend with letterbox subtraction. The compact-library part is a D055 decision with a valid reason: VLC's sub-margin is vertical only.
- (f7) The bridge root cause (media-library duration -1 for external media) is fixed, with a stateSnapshot fallback.

**Hard rules**
- The engine diff (src, lib, include, modules/gui/macosx) is empty.
- The Settings gate is strict: openSettingsDifferences is now empty, and every deviation cites an accepted decision.
- No masks or threshold changes were found.
- Edits outside ownership are declared: MXRServicesBridge.m, WindowCompositionTests and DECISIONS.md.
